cohort: The review focuses on pregnant women living with cystic fibrosis.
finding: Diabetes, both gestational and pre-existing cystic fibrosis-related diabetes (CFRD), is highly prevalent (affecting 18-62% of pregnancies) in pregnant women with CF and has significant implications for maternal and fetal health, including increased risks of preterm delivery, lower gestational age, and lower fetal birth weight.
mod_finding: Diabetes occurring during pregnancy is associated with increased risks of cesarean delivery in women without CF, and small studies suggest similar implications for women with CF.
birth_weight: N/A (Lower fetal birth weight is discussed as an outcome for pregnancies affected by diabetes)
gest_age: N/A (Lower gestational age is discussed as an outcome for pregnancies affected by diabetes)
